#2 [four years later…]

Generally, we don’t have a nicely clean account of reflective localization on any one page. There are bits and pieces distributed over a whole lot of different pages (most of the technical details are in unlikely places, such as reflective sub-(infinity,1)-category, geometric embedding). I’d like to have a good account written up on some page.

Also the textbooks accounts that I have seen are all not really good. Maybe I haven’t seen the good ones…
